entries.en: His risky jokes kept him skating on thin ice at work.
entries.zh: 他那些冒险的玩笑让他在工作中一直如履薄冰。

entries.en: Put the blankets underneath and lay the pillows on top.
entries.zh: 把毯子放在下面，再把枕头放在上面。

entries.en: We only see foxes here once in a blue moon.
entries.zh: 我们在这里见到狐狸真是千载难逢。

entries.en: The lights along the platform went out one after the other.
entries.zh: 站台上的灯相继熄灭了。

entries.en: One of these days, that loose shelf will fall.
entries.zh: 总有一天，那个松动的架子会掉下来。

entries.en: One way or another, we'll get your keys back.
entries.zh: 无论如何，我们会把你的钥匙拿回来。

entries.en: The paint is only just dry; don't touch it yet.
entries.zh: 油漆才刚干，先别碰它。

entries.en: The folding table can open out to seat six.
entries.zh: 这张折叠桌展开后可以坐六个人。

entries.en: The gardens open to the public at ten.
entries.zh: 花园十点向公众开放。

entries.en: Students can opt in before the workshop begins.
entries.zh: 学生可以在研讨课开始前决定参加。

entries.meaningZh: 在其他都相同的情况下
entries.en: Other things being equal, I'd choose the lighter tent.
entries.zh: 在其他都相同的情况下，我会选择较轻的帐篷。

entries.en: Read the whole letter instead of quoting one line out of context.
entries.zh: 请读完整封信，不要脱离上下文地引用其中一句。

entries.en: The airline had overbooked the flight by six seats.
entries.zh: 航空公司为这趟航班接受的预订比可用座位多了六个。

entries.en: Management had overmanned the new shop before sales picked up.
entries.zh: 在销售好转之前，管理层为新店配置了过多人员。

entries.en: We risk overmanning the kitchen if both teams work tonight.
entries.zh: 如果两组人今晚都上班，我们可能会给厨房配置过多人员。

entries.en: Your summary oversimplified a disagreement involving three separate contracts.
entries.zh: 你的摘要把一场涉及三份不同合同的争议过分简单化了。

entries.en: We'll pace off the distance before ordering the fence.
entries.zh: 订购围栏前，我们会用步子量出距离。

entries.en: Can you pace out ten metres along this wall?
entries.zh: 你能沿着这面墙用步子量出十米吗？

entries.en: That tiny speaker can pack a punch in a small room.
entries.zh: 那个小音箱在小房间里也能发出强劲有力的声音。

entries.en: He's ready to pack in the night shifts after Christmas.
entries.zh: 他准备圣诞节后不再上夜班。

entries.en: How many people can pack into that tiny lift?
entries.zh: 那个小电梯能挤进多少人？

entries.en: We had to pack off the children before the meeting.
entries.zh: 我们得在开会前把孩子们打发走。

entries.en: The market traders began to pack up as snow fell.
entries.zh: 下雪时，市场上的摊贩开始收摊了。

entries.en: Don't pad out the report with pages of repeated figures.
entries.zh: 不要用好几页重复的数据来凑报告的篇幅。

entries.en: A joint statement cannot paper over their dispute about funding.
entries.zh: 一份联合声明掩盖不了他们在资金问题上的争执。

entries.en: Cheap gifts won't paper over the cracks in their friendship.
entries.zh: 廉价的礼物掩盖不了他们友谊中的裂痕。

entries.en: She was paragliding above the bay when the wind changed.
entries.zh: 风向改变时，她正在海湾上空进行滑翔伞运动。

entries.en: He repeated the safety instructions parrot-fashion without understanding them.
entries.zh: 他不懂安全说明，却鹦鹉学舌般地重复着。

entries.en: I must part company with you over that final claim.
entries.zh: 关于最后那个说法，我得和你持不同意见。

entries.en: The dealer accepted my old bike in part exchange for a new one.
entries.zh: 经销商接受我用旧自行车抵付一部分新车款。

entries.en: Please don't pass the buck when the figures are wrong.
entries.zh: 数据有误时，请不要推卸责任。

entries.en: We'll pass the hat to help repair the village hall.
entries.zh: 我们会募捐，帮助修缮村礼堂。

entries.en: She stopped to pass the time of day with the gatekeeper.
entries.zh: 她停下来和看门人打了个招呼。

entries.en: You can passivize this clause without changing its tense.
entries.zh: 你可以把这个分句改成被动式，而不改变它的时态。

entries.en: We managed to patch together the missing pages from several damaged copies.
entries.zh: 我们设法从几份残缺的副本中拼凑出了缺失的页面。

entries.en: Please pay attention to the numbers on the luggage tags.
entries.zh: 请注意行李牌上的号码。

entries.en: You should pay heed to the carpenter's warning about that ladder.
entries.zh: 你应该听取木匠对那架梯子的警告。

entries.en: The council pedestrianized the narrow street beside the museum.
entries.zh: 市政当局把博物馆旁的窄街改成了步行街。

entries.en: Nobody expected the villain to peg out so early in the novel.
entries.zh: 谁都没想到那个反派会在小说里那么早就死掉。

entries.en: I'll phone up the repair shop after lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后我会给修理店打电话。

entries.en: With only two rooms available, we couldn't pick and choose.
entries.zh: 只剩两个房间，我们没法挑挑拣拣。

entries.en: The editor always tries to pick holes in my reasoning.
entries.zh: 那位编辑总想挑我推理中的毛病。

entries.en: Stop trying to pick on your colleague for being late.
entries.zh: 别再因为同事迟到就找对方的岔子了。

entries.en: Did you pick up on the hesitation in her reply?
entries.zh: 你注意到她回答时的迟疑了吗？

entries.en: After the shop closed, we had to pick up the pieces.
entries.zh: 店铺关门后，我们不得不收拾残局。

entries.en: The host offered to pick up the tab for everyone's lunch.
entries.zh: 东道主提出为所有人的午餐付账。

entries.en: After the interruption, she tried to pick up the threads of her argument.
entries.zh: 中断之后，她试着接着讲述自己的论点。

entries.en: Detectives tried to piece together the torn note.
entries.zh: 侦探们试图把撕碎的便条拼起来。

entries.en: Don't pigeon-hole her as a comic actor after one performance.
entries.zh: 不要看过一次演出就把她归为喜剧演员。

entries.en: Our pianist is ill; could you pinch-hit at tonight's rehearsal?
entries.zh: 我们的钢琴师病了；今晚排练时你能临时顶替吗？

entries.meaningZh: 胡闹；工作吊儿郎当〔粗俗〕
entries.en: We can't afford to piss around when the deadline is tonight.
entries.zh: 截止时间就在今晚，我们不能再吊儿郎当地瞎折腾。

entries.en: It began to piss down just as the picnic started.
entries.zh: 野餐刚开始，天就下起了大雨。

entries.en: Don't piss off the neighbours with music at midnight.
entries.zh: 别半夜放音乐把邻居惹恼了。

entries.en: Our decision will pivot on the cost of repairing the roof.
entries.zh: 我们的决定将取决于修理屋顶的费用。

entries.en: I plan on visiting the archive next week.
entries.zh: 我打算下周去档案馆。

entries.en: Let's plan out the seating before the guests arrive.
entries.zh: 我们在客人到达前把座位安排好吧。

entries.en: You'll need to plane down this edge before fitting the drawer.
entries.zh: 装入抽屉前，你得把这条边刨薄一些。

entries.en: Wait for warmer weather before you plant out the seedlings.
entries.zh: 等天气暖和些再把幼苗移植到户外。

entries.en: I decided to play along with his story until we were alone.
entries.zh: 我决定暂时附和他的说法，直到只剩我们两个人。

entries.en: The children like to play at running a restaurant.
entries.zh: 孩子们喜欢假装经营一家餐馆。

entries.en: The violinist learned to play by ear before reading music.
entries.zh: 那位小提琴手在学会读谱之前就学会了凭听觉记忆演奏。

entries.en: The negotiator tried to play for time by requesting another document.
entries.zh: 谈判代表试图通过索要另一份文件来拖延，以争取时间。

entries.en: You could play into someone's hands by revealing the password.
entries.zh: 你透露密码，可能会正中某人的下怀。

entries.en: She tried to play it cool when the invitation arrived.
entries.zh: 邀请送来时，她努力装出冷静的样子。

entries.en: We decided to play it safe and take the earlier train.
entries.zh: 我们决定求稳，乘坐较早的那趟火车。

entries.en: The referee waved for the teams to play on.
entries.zh: 裁判挥手示意两队继续比赛。

entries.en: With rain forecast, the climbers chose to play safe.
entries.zh: 预报有雨，登山者选择不冒险。

entries.en: She refused to play second fiddle to her younger sister.
entries.zh: 她不肯屈居妹妹之下。

entries.en: Don't play the fool while we're carrying this glass panel.
entries.zh: 我们抬这块玻璃板时，别做蠢事。

entries.en: There is no need to play-act when you dislike the food.
entries.zh: 你不喜欢这些食物，就没有必要装模作样。

entries.en: The children were play-acting behind the curtain before the show.
entries.zh: 演出前，孩子们在幕布后假扮角色。

entries.meaningZh: 把利润再投资〔英式拼写〕
entries.en: They intend to plough back the profits into better equipment.
entries.zh: 他们打算把利润再投入到更好的设备上。

entries.en: How much money can we plough into the repairs?
entries.zh: 我们能往修缮工作中投入多少钱？

entries.en: The ferry had to plough through rough water to reach the island.
entries.zh: 渡轮不得不乘风破浪，才能到达那座岛。

entries.en: They hired a tractor to plough up the neglected field.
entries.zh: 他们租了一辆拖拉机来犁那块荒芜的田。

entries.en: Don't point the finger at the driver before checking the brakes.
entries.zh: 检查刹车之前，别先指责司机。

entries.en: We had an afternoon to poke around the old market.
entries.zh: 我们有一个下午可以在老市场闲逛。

entries.en: It's unkind to poke fun at someone learning a new language.
entries.zh: 取笑正在学习一门新语言的人是不友善的。

entries.en: He post-dated the cheque to match his next payday.
entries.zh: 他把支票日期往后填到了下一个发薪日。

entries.en: We watched her potter about the garden before breakfast.
entries.zh: 早饭前，我们看着她在花园里闲荡。

entries.en: Check the cable before you power up the recorder.
entries.zh: 给录音机加电之前，先检查电缆。

entries.en: The volunteers had pre-packed the lunches before the walkers arrived.
entries.zh: 步行者到达之前，志愿者已经把午餐预先包装好了。

entries.en: The builders intend to press ahead despite the delivery delays.
entries.zh: 尽管交货延误，施工人员仍打算继续推进工作。

entries.meaningZh: 强迫某人做不愿做的事
entries.en: They tried to press-gang me into organising the raffle.
entries.zh: 他们想强拉我去组织抽奖活动。

entries.en: The overnight storm destroyed pretty well everything in the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 夜里的风暴几乎毁掉了温室里的一切。

entries.en: The council hopes new grants will prime the pump for local businesses.
entries.zh: 市政当局希望新的补助能促进本地企业发展。

entries.en: Could you print out the map before we leave?
entries.zh: 出发前，你能把地图打印出来吗？

entries.en: The boy was prodding the mud with a fallen twig.
entries.zh: 那个男孩正用一根落下的细枝戳泥。

entries.en: She took a second job to provide for her family.
entries.zh: 她又找了一份工作来供养家人。

entries.meaningZh: 在心理上震慑；使紧张〔俚语〕
entries.en: The opposing team tried to psych out our goalkeeper before the match.
entries.zh: 对方球队试图在赛前在心理上震慑我们的守门员。

entries.en: The toddler tried to pull away from his father's grip.
entries.zh: 那个幼儿试图从父亲的手中挣脱。

entries.en: Our train will pull into the station after midnight.
entries.zh: 我们的火车将于午夜后进站。

entries.en: We need to pump out the cellar before inspecting the walls.
entries.zh: 检查墙壁之前，我们得先把地下室里的水抽空。

entries.en: He kept punning on my surname throughout the journey.
entries.zh: 旅途中，他一直拿我的姓氏说双关语。

entries.en: The team will push ahead once the materials arrive.
entries.zh: 材料一到，团队就会继续推进工作。

entries.en: I tried to finish, but he kept trying to push in.
entries.zh: 我想把话说完，他却一直想粗鲁地插嘴。

entries.en: We should push off before the roads get busy.
entries.zh: 我们应该在路上拥挤起来之前离开。

entries.en: A strong gust could push over that loose fence.
entries.zh: 一阵强风就可能把那道松动的围栏推倒。

entries.meaningZh: 讲排场；热烈庆祝〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: They decided to push the boat out for their silver wedding.
entries.zh: 他们决定大张旗鼓地庆祝银婚纪念日。

entries.en: The cancelled concert put a damper on our weekend.
entries.zh: 音乐会取消，扫了我们周末的兴。

entries.en: During the inspection, the nervous apprentice didn't put a foot wrong.
entries.zh: 检查期间，紧张的学徒没有做错任何事。

entries.en: The new lock should put a stop to these break-ins.
entries.zh: 新锁应该能结束这些入室盗窃事件。

entries.en: Who put about that rumour concerning the missing money?
entries.zh: 是谁散布了那条有关钱款失踪的谣言？

entries.en: The heavy rain put an end to our outdoor rehearsal.
entries.zh: 大雨终止了我们的户外排练。

entries.en: She tries to put by a little money each week.
entries.zh: 她每周都尽量存下一点钱备用。

entries.en: You're not someone I'd put down as a nervous speaker.
entries.zh: 我不会认为你是个容易紧张的演讲者。

entries.en: The delay could be put down to poor planning.
entries.zh: 这次延误可以归因于计划不周。

entries.en: Several residents put forth a cheaper solution at the meeting.
entries.zh: 几位居民在会上提出了一个更便宜的解决方案。

entries.en: He promised to put in an appearance before catching his train.
entries.zh: 他答应赶火车前来露个面。

entries.en: I plan to put in for a transfer next month.
entries.zh: 我打算下个月申请调动。

entries.en: She finally put pen to paper after weeks of planning.
entries.zh: 经过几周的构思，她终于落笔了。

entries.en: Please put the clock back ten minutes; it's running fast.
entries.zh: 请把钟拨慢十分钟；它走快了。

entries.en: Seeing the empty cage, I began to put two and two together.
entries.zh: 看到空笼子后，我开始根据事实推断原委。

entries.en: I can't put up with that dripping tap any longer.
entries.zh: 我再也受不了那个滴水的水龙头了。

entries.en: The repair wasn't expensive; quite the contrary, it cost nothing.
entries.zh: 维修并不贵；正相反，一分钱都没花。

entries.en: "The bridge is gone," quoth the weary messenger.
entries.zh: “桥已经不见了，”疲惫的信使说道。

entries.en: The match was rained off shortly before kick-off.
entries.zh: 比赛在开赛前不久因雨取消了。

entries.en: The vegetable stall opens at six, rain or shine.
entries.zh: 蔬菜摊不论晴雨都在六点开张。

entries.en: His extravagance might raise an eyebrow at the office.
entries.zh: 他的奢侈作风可能会在办公室引起怀疑。

entries.en: The night guard hurried to raise the alarm about the smoke.
entries.zh: 夜班保安赶紧发出警报，提醒有烟雾。

entries.en: Let's not rake over the same quarrel at every family meal.
entries.zh: 我们别在每次家庭聚餐时都把同一场争吵翻出来重提。

entries.en: The workers began to rally around their elected spokesperson.
entries.zh: 工人们开始团结在他们选出的发言人周围。

entries.en: Her friends promised to rally round after the fire.
entries.zh: 火灾过后，她的朋友们答应会来帮她渡过难关。

entries.en: The jeweller installed stronger shutters after the ram-raid.
entries.zh: 飞车撞店抢劫发生后，珠宝商安装了更结实的护窗板。

entries.en: The sergeant began to rap out orders over the engine noise.
entries.zh: 中士开始压过引擎声厉声发出命令。

entries.en: Wrap the used razor blade before putting it in the bin.
entries.zh: 把用过的剃刀刀片包好，再放进垃圾桶。

entries.en: The programme aims to re-educate drivers who repeatedly break traffic rules.
entries.zh: 这个项目旨在对反复违反交通规则的驾驶员进行再培训。

entries.en: The actors will re-enact the trial using the original transcripts.
entries.zh: 演员们将依据原始庭审记录重现那场审判。

entries.en: The band plans to re-form for one final tour.
entries.zh: 乐队打算重新组建，再进行最后一次巡演。

entries.en: Please re-route this parcel through the regional depot.
entries.zh: 请将这个包裹改道，经地区仓库发送。

entries.en: The clerk will read out the names in alphabetical order.
entries.zh: 办事员会按字母顺序读出姓名。

entries.en: I need to read up on the dispute before tomorrow's interview.
entries.zh: 明天采访前，我需要研究一下这场争议。

entries.en: The frightened horse began to rear up beside the gate.
entries.zh: 受惊的马开始在大门旁抬起前腿直立。

entries.en: It was difficult to reason with him while he was shouting.
entries.zh: 他大喊大叫时，很难和他讲道理。

entries.en: The manufacturer decided to rebadge the van for overseas markets.
entries.zh: 制造商决定为面向海外市场的厢式车更换标识。

entries.en: The charity hired a designer to help rebrand its campaign.
entries.zh: 那家慈善机构聘请设计师，帮助其宣传活动重塑形象。

entries.en: Don't reckon on finding a parking space near the theatre.
entries.zh: 别指望能在剧院附近找到停车位。

entries.en: The new manager will have to reckon with strong local opposition.
entries.zh: 新任经理将不得不认真应对当地的强烈反对。

entries.en: They seemed to reckon without the cost of storing the equipment.
entries.zh: 他们似乎没有考虑到存放设备的费用。

entries.en: The angler began to reel in the line slowly.
entries.zh: 钓鱼者开始慢慢地把鱼线卷收回来。

entries.en: The crew were refuelling the aircraft when the passengers arrived.
entries.zh: 乘客到达时，机组人员正在给飞机加燃料。

entries.en: The studio will remaster the album from the original tapes.
entries.zh: 录音室将根据原始磁带重新灌录这张专辑。

entries.en: They are remodelling the kitchen to create more storage space.
entries.zh: 他们正在改造厨房的结构，以增加储物空间。

entries.en: The defenders repelled the attack before dawn.
entries.zh: 守军在黎明前击退了进攻。

entries.en: Please report back after you've inspected the damaged roof.
entries.zh: 检查受损的屋顶之后，请回来汇报。

entries.en: We had to reroute our journey after the bridge closed.
entries.zh: 桥梁封闭后，我们不得不改变行程路线。

entries.en: The grant will help former factory workers reskill for different jobs.
entries.zh: 这笔补助将帮助以前的工厂工人为不同的工作学习新技能。

entries.en: The string vibrated resonantly when the nearby tuning fork sounded.
entries.zh: 附近的音叉发声时，那根弦因共鸣而振动。

entries.en: You can rest assured that the parcel is safely stored.
entries.zh: 你可以放心，包裹已妥善存放。

entries.en: The villagers could rest easy once the floodwater had receded.
entries.zh: 洪水退去之后，村民们就可以高枕无忧了。

entries.en: May the old sailor rest in peace beneath these pines.
entries.zh: 愿那位老水手在这些松树下安息。

entries.en: Reverse engineering helped the team understand the obsolete controller.
entries.zh: 逆向工程设计帮助团队理解了那个已淘汰的控制器。

entries.en: These sleeves tend to ride up when I stretch.
entries.zh: 我伸展身体时，这些袖子往往会缩上去。

entries.en: The kettle is boiling right now, so I'll make some tea.
entries.zh: 水壶里的水此刻正沸腾着，我来泡点茶。

entries.en: She recognised the handwriting right off and opened the envelope.
entries.zh: 她立刻认出了笔迹，打开了信封。

entries.en: You can right-click the image to see more options.
entries.zh: 你可以右击图像，查看更多选项。

entries.en: We'll ring around to find a plumber available today.
entries.zh: 我们会到处打电话，找一位今天有空的水管工。

entries.en: Could you ring back when the manager is here?
entries.zh: 经理在的时候，你能再打电话来吗？

entries.en: Please don't ring off before I give you the address.
entries.zh: 我还没告诉你地址之前，请不要挂电话。

entries.en: I'll ring round the local shops before ordering online.
entries.zh: 在网上订购之前，我会给本地商店逐个打电话。

entries.en: The trustees agreed to ring-fence the donation for roof repairs.
entries.zh: 受托人同意将这笔捐款限定用于修缮屋顶。

entries.en: The reviewer began to rip into the film's implausible ending.
entries.zh: 评论者开始猛烈抨击电影里不合情理的结局。

entries.en: Don't rise to the bait when he insults your work.
entries.zh: 他侮辱你的作品时，别上他的当。

entries.en: We searched for shade on that roasting afternoon.
entries.zh: 那个酷热的下午，我们到处找阴凉处。

entries.en: Role playing helped the trainees practise difficult conversations.
entries.zh: 扮演角色帮助受训者练习处理棘手的对话。

entries.en: The agreement will roll back rents to last year's levels.
entries.zh: 协议将把租金调回去年的水平。

entries.en: I learned to roller-skate on the smooth path behind our house.
entries.zh: 我在屋后那条平坦的小路上学会了滑旱冰。

entries.en: They were roller-skating around the empty basketball court.
entries.zh: 他们正在空荡的篮球场上滑旱冰。

entries.en: The dog began to root about beneath the fallen leaves.
entries.zh: 那只狗开始在落叶底下翻找。

entries.en: The review called for reforming the system root and branch.
entries.zh: 审查报告要求彻底改革这个制度。

entries.en: Untreated wooden posts can rot away in damp soil.
entries.zh: 未经处理的木桩会在潮湿的土壤里腐烂。

entries.en: She disliked the rough and tumble of local politics.
entries.zh: 她不喜欢地方政治中的激烈竞争。

entries.en: The guests should arrive round about half past six.
entries.zh: 客人们应该会在六点半左右到。

entries.en: I expected advice, but she began to round on me instead.
entries.zh: 我本来期待得到建议，她却开始冲我发火。

entries.en: The exhibition gave young artists a chance to rub elbows with collectors.
entries.zh: 展览让年轻艺术家有机会与收藏家交往。

entries.en: Use your fingertips to rub in the polish evenly.
entries.zh: 用指尖将上光剂均匀地擦进去。

entries.en: At the reception, students could rub shoulders with visiting writers.
entries.zh: 招待会上，学生们可以接近来访的作家。

entries.en: The argument over the boundary could rumble on for years.
entries.zh: 关于边界的争论可能会持续多年。

entries.en: She stroked her chin ruminatively before answering the question.
entries.zh: 回答问题之前，她沉思着摸了摸下巴。

entries.en: A careless joke can run afoul of the club's rules.
entries.zh: 一个不经心的玩笑可能会与俱乐部的规定冲突。

entries.en: Two guards had to run after the escaped prisoner.
entries.zh: 两名守卫不得不追捕那个逃跑的囚犯。

entries.en: You cannot run away from the decision forever.
entries.zh: 你不能永远逃避这个决定。

entries.en: The strongest team could run away with the championship this year.
entries.zh: 最强的那支队伍今年可能轻易夺冠。

entries.en: When the gate swung open, we decided to run for it.
entries.zh: 大门一打开，我们就决定赶紧逃跑。

entries.en: His blunt remarks could run foul of the committee chair.
entries.zh: 他直率的评论可能会得罪委员会主席。
